verdict.rationale: TypeSafe publishes model-level transparency material without a formal model or system card. There is a version-specific limitations page for jev-1.13 listing nine failure modes with mitigations, and a models page covering versioned IDs, context limits and data handling (not trained on customer data, same weights for every account), from which intended use can be inferred. Missing for 10: a consolidated model/system card, any description of the training approach or architecture, published evaluation or benchmark results for the model itself (the cookbook accuracy figures are task-level demos), and an explicit intended-use / out-of-scope statement.
